title: Java Concurrency & Multithreading
intro: Java concurrency is the most-asked advanced Java topic and the one where depth most clearly separates candidates. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the Java Memory Model (happens-before, visibility — the foundation everything else rests on), then threads and their lifecycle, then synchronization and locks (the primitives). Concurrent collections and thread pools follow at the core-mechanics tier, then CompletableFuture (the async composition most code uses). The advanced tier covers virtual threads (the Java 21 revolution) and concurrency patterns. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
